newsitem.title: JAPAN: Key Dec JGB futures end at all-time high in Tokyo.
newsitem.headline: Key Dec JGB futures end at all-time high in Tokyo.

text.p: The key December Japanese government bond (JGB) futures contract ended Wednesday's Tokyo session sharply higher, boosted by strong buying interest in both cash and futures, traders said.

JGB futures gave up some gains in early afternoon on a news agency report quoting an LDP official as saying that the Bank of Japan (BOJ) should raise its discount rate to the one percent level from the current 0.5 percent, traders said.
The December, however, soon bounced back up. It closed up 0.69 at 125.19, a record high for any benchmark contract listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

According to the report, the Liberal Democratic Party's public relations chief, Shizuka Kamei, also said that he expects the government to compile a supplementary budget worth about seven to eight trillion yen.
The size of the extra budget called by Kamei is bigger than the five trillion yen budget suggested by LDP policy research council chief, Taku Yamazaki, prior to the October 20 general election.
However, the impact of Kamei's remarks was short-lived because he is not considered to be one of the more influential members of the LDP, traders said.
